events.verdict: Murray (DEN) places both hands on Curry (GSW) before releasing away, and the contact is marginal.
Curry (GSW) reaches in and initiates contact with Jokic (DEN) that affects his SQBR.
Horford (GSW) initiates illegal contact with Jokic's (DEN) arm, which affects his layup attempt.
Green (GSW) and Jokic (DEN) engage in marginal contact as Jokic attempts to maneuver around the screen.
Braun (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position during Curry's (GSW) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Murray (DEN) establishes a position in Green's (GSW) path and does not deliver contact.
Butler III (GSW) establishes a position in Braun's (DEN) path as he sets the screen. Although he briefly has an arm around Braun, he immediately removes it without affecting his FOM.
Green (GSW) firms up in a screening position in Murray's (DEN) path and absorbs the contact as the two players come together.
Green (GSW) retracts his arm into a vertical position as Jokic (DEN) begins his upward shooting motion.
Kuminga (GSW) bats the rebound away and the ensuing contact with Jokic (DEN) while the ball is loose is incidental.
Horford (GSW) lowers his hand into Jokic's (DEN) hand after the release of his jump shot, but the contact is marginal.
Braun (DEN) briefly engages with Kuminga (GSW) as he attempts to maneuver around the screen.
Jokic (DEN) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Curry's (GSW) possession during the layup attempt.
Butler III (GSW) reaches in and brushes Gordon's (DEN) arm, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Kuminga (GSW) legally contests Jokic's (DEN) post shot attempt.
Murray (DEN) grazes Curry's (GSW) left arm after his gather as he contests his layup attempt.
